item.title: Ledgerly raises $4.5M seed round to automate month-end close for SMBs
item.dc:creator: Sam Writer
item.description:
Austin-based Ledgerly, a fintech startup building AI bookkeeping agents for small businesses, has raised a $4.5 million seed round led by Northpeak Ventures. The company plans to double its team and build out its go-to-market team in 2027.

The post Ledgerly raises $4.5M appeared first on Startup Wire.

item.title: Exclusive: Brightpath Robotics lands $22M Series A led by Ironfield Capital
item.content:encoded: Brightpath Robotics, which makes warehouse picking robots, closed a $22 million Series A. CEO Dana Ortiz said the money will fund expansion into Europe and a new office in Rotterdam.
